title: Contextual version locking panel with interactive performance timeline
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Add a compact, contextual decision panel in the Console that lets engineers pin a model version for a route while simultaneously inspecting an interactive performance timeline and quick rollback preview. Goal is to reduce friction for safe pinning decisions and to make performance regressions, latency tails, and cost trade-offs visible inline before a pin is applied.
background: Customers frequently ask for a faster way to pin versions during incidents and experiments. Current workflow requires hopping between the version explorer, performance dashboards, and release rollout screens. That fragmentation leads to conservative rollouts and longer incident MTTD. Previous PM work (PM-41234) scoped a model pinning composer; this ticket builds an alternative compact panel that surfaces temporal perf data, recent A/B snapshots, and traffic simulation in one place for low-friction decisions.
user_stories: As an SRE, I want to pin a known-good model version for a route from the route detail page so I can stop a regression quickly.
As a product engineer, I want to preview how a pin will affect recent latency pctiles and token cost on our typical request set before committing.
As a platform owner, I want a short human-readable ‘pin recipe’ I can paste into runbooks to recreate a rollback.
proposed_solution: Introduce a right-side 'Decision Panel' anchor on route/model detail screens that opens on 'Pin version' action.

Panel sections: header with version summary + confidence badge; interactive performance timeline (7/30-day toggles) with pctile overlays; sample prompt set toggle (production vs. dev) to reweight timeline; traffic-slice preview with simulated 1/5/10% traffic routing and estimated cost delta.
Provide a 'Preview rollout' modal showing canary steps (10/20/50) and an estimated risk score computed from recent regression signals.
Include an exportable pin-recipe (JSON blob) and a 'Shadow test' button to run 100 requests through the candidate version without routing live traffic.
Default to non-destructive: 'Apply pin' requires a typed confirmation unless a canary rollout is selected.
Telemetry events for every preview/preview-toggle/confirmation to instrument UX effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Decision Panel opens from route and model-detail pages via 'Pin version' affordance.
Interactive timeline renders 7-day and 30-day windows, supporting p50/p95/p99 overlays and a hover tooltip with sample queries and token counts.
Preview rollout computes and displays estimated latency and cost deltas for 1/5/10% traffic slices using the route's production prompt set.
Shadow test runs against a configurable sample set and stores output in a temporary S3 location for inspection (link in panel).
Apply pin can be executed as immediate or canary; immediate pins require typed confirmation; canary pins create rollout records visible in Console rollouts page.
Pin-recipe can be copied and includes model key, version, rollout strategy, and timestamp.
All user actions emit analytics: panel_open, timeline_toggle, preview_rollout, apply_pin, cancel_pin.
Unit and E2E tests for panel open/close, preview computations, and telemetry exist in corresponding repos.
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only feature flag for platform + SRE (2 weeks)
Beta: opt-in orgs + telemetry enabled (3 weeks)
GA: default available with non-destructive confirmation (target console-2026.04)
qa_notes: Verify timeline percentile calculations match existing performance service for multiple aggregation windows.
Validate preview cost math using real tokenization for the selected sample prompts.
Test shadow-run isolation so outputs are not stored with production request logs.
Accessibility: panel must be keyboard-navigable and meet color contrast for confidence badges.
